diagnosis.micro: The first parent adjudication required a canonical child evolution-evidence entrypoint but did not explicitly require durable preservation of the causal path for evolution-relevant/material problems.
diagnosis.macro: A parent controller cannot reliably guide future repair/generalization if child evidence collapses a problem into only current status and final fix; however UAOS must not prescribe one journal format or log every trivial event.
diagnosis.assumption_challenged: Discoverability of open/resolved references alone is sufficient evolution evidence for later learning and parent guidance.

external_method_evidence: Google SRE postmortem practice preserves how an incident unfolded, impact, response, root causes and follow-up so failures become reusable learning rather than only closed tickets.
Architecture Decision Record practice preserves context, considered alternatives, rationale and consequences so later maintainers can understand why a decision was made.
counterexamples_and_scope_bounds: A-share may encode causal evidence in replay/freeze and market-day records rather than a prose journal.
Video may encode it in work-order, decision receipt, invocation and attestation evidence.
Novel may encode it in checkpoint/canon/project records.
Small local defects may use a compact record; forcing full postmortems for every typo or harmless transient error would create maintenance noise and meta-overproduction.

maintenance_execution_incident.observed: Three create-file attempts were issued before the candidate branch existed; GitHub returned 404 each time.
maintenance_execution_incident.impact: No repository mutation occurred because GitHub rejected the requests.
maintenance_execution_incident.diagnosis: The mutation sequence lacked an explicit branch-existence admission before file writes.
maintenance_execution_incident.repair: Create the candidate branch first and continue only after branch creation succeeds.
maintenance_execution_incident.lesson: Material GitHub maintenance should verify candidate isolation exists before any file mutation request.

Small local defects may use compact records; no heavyweight universal postmortem requirement was created.
